title: Route Chat text into the authorized workspace-search Skill
goal: Enable an installed module-backed workspace search Skill to accept Chat text and return a verified result through the production M8 route.
context: M8 chat routing serializes input as {text: ...}, while ToolModule-backed workspace search requires an arguments JSON object. This shape mismatch makes a correctly registered workspace-search Skill fail from Chat even though direct executeSkill works.
forbidden_changes: Do not execute arbitrary code or operation names from Skill.md metadata.
Do not permit adapters other than the explicit workspace.search adapter for module tool.workspace.read.
Do not bypass ModuleRuntime policy/capability checks or Skill output verification.
Do not modify App/ or Xcode project files.
acceptance_criteria: SkillMarkdownParser preserves an explicit chatInputAdapter metadata field.
Only chatInputAdapter=workspace.search with moduleID=tool.workspace.read can translate {text} into the fixed read-only search operation.
A production M8 test creates a Skill.md and Agent scope, routes Chat intent, searches a workspace file through ModuleRuntime, and asserts the verified result includes the expected path.
Malformed or unsupported adapter metadata fails closed.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, macOS Xcode iOS arm64 build/unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert the adapter and integration test if the supported Skill contract or fail-closed behavior regresses.
